P5Passive

Passive LP/HP

Two gentle filters, no power needed

One low-pass and one high-pass at 6 dB/octave each. Use them separately or in series as a band-pass.

  • Low-pass about 158 Hz to 16 kHz
  • High-pass about 16 Hz to 1.6 kHz
  • LP output normalled to HP input
Width4 HP · 20.1 mm
Height3 U · 128.5 mm
Jacks4
Knobs2
